api-group.description: The API group reported in the Kubernetes object reference.

audit-id.description: The native auditID shared by stages for this API request.

audit-level.description: The audit policy level reported for this stage.

authorization-decision.description: The decision in the Kubernetes authorization.k8s.io/decision annotation.

authorization-reason.description: The reason in the Kubernetes authorization.k8s.io/reason annotation.

impersonated-user-group.description: A reported group of the impersonated Kubernetes principal.

impersonated-user-uid.description: The reported UID of the impersonated Kubernetes principal.

ip-src.description: An IP from the reported sourceIPs chain. Client-controlled values may appear in this chain.

namespace.description: The namespace reported in the Kubernetes object reference.

object-api-version.description: The API version reported in the Kubernetes object reference.

object-name.description: The name of the target object reported by Kubernetes.

object-uid.description: The reported UID of the target Kubernetes object.

provider-account-id.description: The account ID reported by the CloudWatch Logs subscription.

provider-category.description: The audit category in the Azure diagnostic export.

provider-event-id.description: The provider's log event identifier, separate from the Kubernetes audit ID.

provider-log-group.description: The log group reported by the CloudWatch Logs export.

provider-log-stream.description: The log stream reported by the CloudWatch Logs export.

provider-pod.description: The API server pod reported in the AKS Log Analytics row.

provider-resource-id.description: The Azure resource ID reported for this log record.

provider-table.description: The Azure Log Analytics table type reported for this row.

request-time.description: The time the Kubernetes API server received the request, normalized to UTC.

request-time-raw.description: The request-received timestamp as reported in the audit record.

request-uri.description: The request URI as sent to the Kubernetes API server.

resource.description: The resource type reported in the Kubernetes object reference.

response-code.description: The numeric code from the Kubernetes responseStatus.

response-message.description: The message from the Kubernetes responseStatus.

response-reason.description: The reason from the Kubernetes responseStatus.

response-status.description: The status from the Kubernetes responseStatus.

service-account.description: The authenticated service account as namespace/name, derived from its Kubernetes username.

source-address.description: One original entry in the reported sourceIPs chain, in source order.

source-format.description: The input export format in which this stage observation was found.

stage.description: The request handling stage reported by Kubernetes.

stage-time.description: The stage timestamp normalized to UTC.

stage-time-raw.description: The original timestamp for this Kubernetes audit stage.

subresource.description: The subresource reported in the Kubernetes object reference.

user-agent.description: The user agent reported by the Kubernetes client.

user-group.description: A reported group of the authenticated Kubernetes principal.

user-uid.description: The reported UID of the authenticated Kubernetes principal.

username.description: The authenticated username reported by the Kubernetes API server.

verb.description: The Kubernetes API verb, or the lowercased HTTP method for a non-resource request.

description: An observed stage of a Kubernetes API audit request, recording the reported identity, API target and response.
name: kubernetes-audit-stage
